notes.title: Update Notes for March 26, 2025 (v1.4)
notes.notes:
Fixed a couple of minor bugs:
[list]
[*]Tutorial text was overflowing when playing in 16:9
[*]The cursor that's used when playing with a controller wasn't going away if the player was using keyboard & mouse
[*]The player's health wasn't updating on the map screen UI after going into the heal room
[/list]
Happy Rolling!

notes.title: Update Notes for September 7, 2022 (v1.2)
notes.notes:
To increase playability on the Steam Deck, Battle Rollers now supports a native 16:10 aspect ratio with added controller support!
The game is now fully playable on deck using a mixture of the deck's controller buttons (for example: movement with the Dpad, rolling with the A button, and more), as well as using the touch pads or touch screen to access things like the menu!

notes.title: Update Notes for June 27, 2021 (v1.1)
notes.notes:
As per a request from the community, I have added a way to see the "Game Info" page that appears on the map screen when you are doing the tutorial. 
You can see this "Game Info" page by hitting "tab" on your keyboard on the map screen, or the battle screen!
